Priya: Heads up — I'm drafting the SI ramp + certification ladder for new HW marketplace partners. Need SI-ops, training, and marketing input. Goal: clear badge levels, lab access, marketplace listing requirements, and a joint announce window.
Sam: +1 on badge levels. Thinking 3 tiers: Associate -> Specialist -> Integrator. Each tier = lab pass + case study. Can we define acceptance criteria?
Jorge: For labs we need voucher flow + a sandbox GPU pool. Hardware partners want a limited set of reference configs (A100-40GB, L40s-lite). We should list exact images and kernel versions.
Elliot: Training content format? I recommend 3 deliverables per module: slide deck, hands-on lab (terraform + container), and eval harness. Suggest naming: si-mod-{tier}-{module} e.g., si-mod-associate-deploy
marketplace-bot: auto-checklist: marketplace listing must include: logo, SKUs, supported models, latency SLA, contact. See /docs/marketplace/listing-guide :white_check_mark:
Maria: Marketing: what's the target announce window? We need 2 weeks for co-branded assets + legal review. Any preferred weeks in Q2?
Priya: Proposal: pilot cohort start May 11, public enablement June 1. Partner PR week targeted June 8. Thoughts?
Sam: May 11 pilot works. For certification exam: 45-min practical + 15-min short answers. Pass = 70% for Associate, 80% Specialist, 90% Integrator.
Jorge: We should include an eval harness that runs model + perf tests. I can add a CI job that runs against a reference prompt set and checks latency percentiles.
Elliot: I wrote a tiny verifier: 
```
# run cert verifier
./si-cert-checker --lab-url https://sandbox.redwood.ai --badge specialist --timeout 30m
```
Will put it on GitHub and wire an API token flow for voucher redemption.
Maria: For joint PR, legal needs full partner logo/boilerplate by May 20. Can partners provide case study quotes during pilot wrap?
Priya: Agree. Action items:
- Sam: draft exam rubric + badge assets by Apr 28
- Jorge: CI eval job + reference images by May 4
- Elliot: cert-checker repo + voucher flow by May 4
- Maria: co-brand checklist + PR template by May 20
Who's in for a 30-min sync tomorrow 11am PT? :calendar:
Sam: I'll be there :thumbsup:
Jorge: me
Elliot: in
Maria: can join for first 20
Priya: adding meeting link in calendar now — thanks all
